abilities.name: Arcane Missiles
abilities.description: Launches a volley of arcane missiles at the target, dealing Arcane damage. A slow cast.
_tuning: 15 Nov 2026, class pass deep dive: ADDED. The Arcane spec had no single-target Arcane spell - its rotation was Fireball and Frostbolt (62% of its damage Fire) and its talents had been re-aimed at them (tools/build_mage_arcane.py: 'Arcane's own spells are mostly absent'). Classic's Arcane Missiles: trained at 8, ranked every 8 levels to 56. Slow cast (Classic's 5-second channel): 1.5x a Fireball rank for 1.15x its cost, on the authored line.

abilities.name: Blast Wave
abilities.description: A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, dealing heavy Fire damage to all nearby enemies.
abilities._source: Real Classic WoW Fire talent: 'A wave of flame radiates outward from the caster, dealing X to Y Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yards.' Built during the DPS niche audit (Oct 2026) to replace the dead version of the Blast Wave talent, which was literally named after this real spell but only trimmed Arcane Explosion's cooldown instead of being its own ability - the exact 'templated filler, no _source citation' pattern flagged by the audit. Gives Fire Mage its own instant AoE nuke, mechanically distinct from Arcane Explosion (shared baseline) and from the new Blizzard DoT (Frost) below.

abilities.name: Blizzard
abilities.description: Ice shards pelt the target area, dealing Frost damage over time to all enemies within it.
abilities._source: Real Classic WoW Frost spell (trained, with 'Improved Blizzard' as a real talent upgrade). Built during the DPS niche audit (Oct 2026) to replace the dead 'Improved Blizzard' talent, which assumed a baseline Blizzard ability that never existed in this game and only buffed Arcane Explosion instead - the same 'templated filler, no _source citation' pattern as Blast Wave above. Renamed the talent to grant Blizzard itself directly (same requires_talent/unlock_ability shape as Priest's Mind Sear), rather than half-building an 'Improved' upgrade on top of a baseline that still wouldn't exist. Real WoW channels this over 8 sec with no separate cast - simplified to a spell_dot here, same simplification Mind Sear already uses for this engine's lack of a channel mechanic. Gives Frost Mage a sustained AoE DoT identity, distinct from Fire's instant Blast Wave nuke and from the shared baseline Arcane Explosion.
_tuning: 21 Nov 2026: a slow cast for the turn timeline (tools/build_cast_speeds.py), sized 1.5x for 1.15x the cost

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.description: Blasts the enemies in front of you with frost, freezing them in place for 2 turns.
abilities._source: FROST NOVA FREEZES (Kyle, 20 Nov 2026, chose 'Frost Nova freezes' for the mage's survival). It was a 3-turn slow (-20 haste) on a 3-turn cooldown and kept nothing off you. Now it hits one row for a little frost damage (about half an Arcane Explosion, like Classic) and freezes it: a frozen enemy loses its turns, the turn-based form of Classic's root that a melee mob can't reach you through. 2 turns on a 6-turn cooldown (Classic's 25 seconds); it's crowd control, so it costs the turn. Stuns diminish (combat/status_effects.py): a rare or a boss is frozen one turn and can't be frozen again for four. Breaking on damage has no hook, so it holds.

abilities.name: Ice Barrier
abilities.description: Surrounds you with ice, absorbing incoming damage.
abilities._design_note: Not learned from level alone - granted by the Ice Barrier talent in the Frost tree, matching real WOTLK where this is talent-exclusive to Frost, not a baseline ability. Surrounds you with ice, absorbing incoming damage.
abilities._source: ICE BARRIER DID NOT ABSORB ANYTHING. Its own description says 'surrounds you with ice, absorbing incoming damage' and it carried no absorb at all - just {"armor": 150, "magic_resistance": 60}, armour and resistance standing in for the mechanic. In Classic this spell is a pure absorb shield, and the engine has supported absorbs the whole time (StatusEffect.absorb soaks the RAW incoming amount before every other defensive stat, see Character.take_damage). 22 abilities across the CoA classes already use absorb_pct_max_health, a FRACTION of the recipient's max health, in a 0.06-0.40 band; 0.18 matches the cloth peers (Pyromancer's Inferno Barrier 0.16, Chronomancer's Infinite Shield 0.18, Bloodmage's Blood Veil 0.18). The armour/resistance stand-in is REMOVED rather than kept alongside, because keeping both would double-count the same defensive intent and leave Mage's barrier stronger than every peer's - a one-line revert if that trade is unwanted.

abilities.name: Mana Shield
abilities.description: Wraps you in raw mana, absorbing damage for a short time.
abilities._source: REAL ABSORB (20 Nov 2026, fix-up after the levelling run): Mana Shield was a placeholder -25% damage taken for 2 turns because no absorb mechanic existed; one does now (Ice Barrier's absorb_pct_max_health). It absorbs 15% of your health for up to 3 turns (Classic's top rank, 570, was about that share of a level-60 mage's health), against Ice Barrier's talented 18%. The mana-per-point drain isn't modelled, so it costs mana up front, ranked like Ice Barrier. Arcane Shielding's potency scales the absorb. Measured: against mobs three levels up, Fire and Arcane ended fights on 48-55% health at 60 against a median of 88%, while Frost (with Ice Barrier) ended on 97%.

abilities.name: Counterspell
